text: A1a opened: read AGENT, PLATFORM-claude, the contract whole, STANDING, METHOD, HOW-TO-RUN, README-store, WRITING; next: the tools pass, then the package checks

tools pass: mem.py help and every read verb run once with --stage A1 on r/denmark, exit 0 where data exists; scheme, where, rooms --with, adaptations, finding, question, table, diff-scheme, diff-model refuse with a reason because their files do not exist yet; mint, idea, place, unplace, adjudicate refuse at A1 as the stage file says; one cite.py call resolved denmark/c0002. No defect from the tools pass.

departure declared before the saved scripts out/_analysis/a1_checks.py and a1_checks2.py: rule 1, for the section 1 checks audit and facts do not serve. Results: census 705 agrees across FRAME, rooms.jsonl, folders, codes, themes; six files and a forest in all 705; retracted 175 agree; store build figures agree; _unjoined 38 recomputed exactly; forest header totals agree with rooms.jsonl forest sums but not with items.jsonl (531851 against 158227, state collapsed undocumented); slopes concepts 0.530, themes 0.231 on items. Five defects written: tenma no canvas, archlinux code at h100.9, n_codes_coder two meanings, items state collapsed, concept reach 1.0 everywhere.

asked QA1-001: Stage A1 section 1 defines concept reach as the share of a room's concepts that carry a theme_id. In this store every one of the 115388 concepts has a theme_id and sits in its theme's code_ids, so the share is 1.0 in all 705 rooms and no room size makes it fall. Did you mean another measure, for example concepts per second-order theme, or the share of concepts a theme's note or label actually describes? The threshold decides where cite.py must reach concepts at C2 to D3. | meanwhile: I declare concept_reach_threshold as 0 items: the measure gives no cut, and second-order themes grow at slope 0.23 on items against 0.53 for concepts, so every room is read at concept level from C2 to D3. I will revise it if your answer names another measure.

screen: read the forest of all 46 rooms with one coded thread (no room has none) and the case account of wario, nonbinary, oltp, tenma, Bravenewbies; no room has a first coded turn after hour 73. Every one wrote about the canvas while it was open, most with a call or a report of placing; none is a negative screen, so dropped.jsonl is written empty and the analysed set is 705 of 705. Doubts kept in notes-A1.md: tenma (no canvas line), UNLincoln (its one thread is about a logo a member says is Northeastern's), yerbamate and watchmen (a notice, no coordination), yogscast (first coded turn at h-18.58 is not about the canvas).

contrast picked on onset_first_code_hour: early, first coded turn in hours 0 to 3 (131 rooms); late, after hour 48 (61 rooms); italy and yogscast on neither side because their first coded turn precedes the canvas. Confound written first: median items_in_window 5067 against 33, so a held-size comparison (items 156 to 2770: 41 against 12) travels with it. out/contrast.md

concept_reach_threshold declared as 0 items_in_window, so every room is read at concept level from C2 to D3: the share as defined is 1.0 in all 705 rooms (every concept carries a theme_id), and second-order themes grow at log-log slope 0.231 on items against 0.530 for concepts. Rests on QA1-001; revised if the answer names another measure.

blocks declared: a seeded shuffle (20261006) of the 705 rooms cut at 3 MB by mem.py's byte count, 19 blocks, r/counting (11.17 MB) a block of its own as block 13; out/order-A1.txt written, 705 lines; mem.py next names anarchism, block 01. Departure logged for the script.

A1a closes with the checks, the screen and the order written: census and analysed set 705, nothing dropped, six defects and two departures, the self-test clean. The contrast is early (h0 to 3, 131 rooms) against late (after h48, 61 rooms), carried with a held-size comparison because size differs a hundredfold; concept_reach_threshold is 0 pending QA1-001. Next is A1b-01, block 01, starting with the room mem.py next names (anarchism).
